answer.answer: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MOPNG) introduced and administers the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 scheme [E01][E02]. The ministry launched the scheme to provide free LPG connections to women from poor households [E01][E02], with the objective of making clean cooking fuel available to rural and deprived households that traditionally relied on firewood, coal, or cow-dung cakes [E02]. The ministry also provides cash assistance for PMUY connections, including security deposits, pressure regulators, LPG hoses, and domestic gas consumer cards [E01].

claim_to_evidence.claim: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas introduced and administers Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
The scheme aims to provide free LPG connections to women from poor households
The ministry provides cash assistance for PMUY connections including security deposits, regulators, hoses, and consumer cards
